candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool.size=5 with idle=0 and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order 503s, order ReadTimeouts, and gateway checkout 502s (~2s).
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres pool metrics or logs admitted; pool saturation inferred from span attributes only.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failing at postgres.save_order with pool size 5 and zero idle connections, DependencyUnavailable, propagating to order 503 and gateway 502. Inventory and payment succeed, isolating the fault to the order-postgres path. Metrics confirm 502s on /v1/checkout with ~2.4s p95.
